request.text: how do I rotate the signing key for the staging webhook?

results.title: Rotating webhook signing keys
results.snippet: 1. In Admin > Webhooks, open the endpoint. 2. Click "Roll secret"; the old secret stays valid for 24 hours. 3. Update WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET in the service secret store. 4. Redeploy the consumer. 5. Confirm deliveries succeed, then click "Expire old secret".

cases.note: Sequential steps belong in a numbered prose list.

thread.text: @Atlas summarize the INC-316 webhook incident

INC-316: On Sep 23 from 18:40 to 19:30 PT, webhook deliveries in ap-southeast-2 were delayed by up to 12 minutes for 38% of workspaces. A queue consumer deploy lowered concurrency from 32 to 4 because of a bad default. On-call rolled back at 18:49, the backlog drained by 19:05, and the incident was resolved at 19:30. Follow-ups: validate concurrency defaults in config, and alert on concurrency drops.
